frequent_questions.title: Frequently Asked Questions
frequent_questions.description: Got any questions that are still bugging you? Don't worry, we've got you covered. Check out our FAQs to get clear and simple answers.

question_answer_list.question: How is the pricing determined?
question_answer_list.answer: The pricing for your project is determined after completing a 3-step process to understand your project's requirements and your specific needs. We offer a fair and transparent pricing structure tailored to your project.

question_answer_list.question: How soon can the work commence?
question_answer_list.answer: Once you've filled out our contact form, our representative will promptly get in touch with you. We follow a simple 3-step process to understand your requirements and formulate a plan. Upon completion, we'll begin the work without delay.

question_answer_list.question: Does Creativate provide ongoing support after project completion?
question_answer_list.answer: Yes, we offer 30 days of post-handover support at no extra cost. Following that, we offer yearly maintenance and support for an additional fee, tailored to the project's needs.

question_answer_list.question: Can Creativate work within specific budget constraints?
question_answer_list.answer: Absolutely. We prioritize understanding your budget constraints and adapt our approach to ensure the delivery of high-quality content aligned with your needs.

question_answer_list.question: Does Creativate offer consultations or initial project assessments?
question_answer_list.answer: Certainly, we provide an initial free consultation to grasp your brand and specific needs. Once the initial assessment is complete, we finalize project requirements and deliverables. Additionally, you can engage our expertise solely as consultants for specific projects within your brand.

question_answer_list.question: How often do you provide analytics or reports for marketing efforts?
question_answer_list.answer: We provide detailed reports on a monthly or project basis, tailored to your needs. These reports include all relevant metrics, and we take the time to explain the data and outline the efforts undertaken to drive results.

This privacy statement (“Privacy Statement”) pertains to the handling of personally identifiable information provided by you or otherwise obtained from you in relation to the associated Website (“https://www.creativate.in”). The website is operated by Creativate. By utilizing or accessing the Website in any way, you acknowledge your acceptance of the practices and policies outlined in this Privacy Statement.

What personal information does Creativate collect?

Personal Information Collected Automatically: Whenever you interact with the Website, certain types of usage-related information are received and stored by Creativate. For instance, Creativate may automatically receive and record information about your computer’s IP address, browser details, Facebook user ID, Facebook Page fan status, and accessed URLs.

How does Creativate utilize the collected information?

Creativate does not employ any of the automatically collected information. This information is never retained on our servers or shared with any third parties.

Will Creativate share any received personal information?

Absolutely not.

Questions or concerns?

Should you have any questions or concerns regarding privacy on our Website, feel free to send us a detailed message at hello@creativate.in. We are committed to addressing your concerns promptly.

This is an example page. It’s different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I’m a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin’ caught in the rain.)

…or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!
